title: Seoul Venture Forum — travel & expense scratchpad
content:
Quick running notes for Seoul Venture Forum — admin, reimbursements, vendor contacts and things to remember.

Top priorities (before departure):
- Confirm booth package pickup window with local logistics vendor (see contact below).
- Upload final attendee list to events portal and badge CSV (deadline 2024-10-10).
- Print 1x shipping label for demo kit and leave copy in travel folder.
- Submit pre-trip Concur hold request for $1,200 (per diem advance if needed).

Flight & lodging
- Flight: SFO -> ICN, itinerary last 4: ABCD, depart 10/15 23:40 local. Double-check visa/entry rules (should be fine).
- Hotel: Lotte City — group rate confirmed under Redwood Inference (check-in 10/16, check-out 10/19). Reservation number in booking link above.

Booth / equipment
- Shipping: KGL Logistics (local partner). Pickup window 10/16 09:00–12:00. Contact: Min-jun Park +82 10-2345-6789, minjun.kgl@example.co.kr.
- Address for shipping label (for returns): KGL Logistics Warehouse, 7-5 Gangnam-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul.
- On-site tech: request AV cable adapter kit + USB-C hub. Confirm arrival at 08:00 on demo day.

Vendors / local contacts
- Interpreter (English <> Korean): Hana Translations — Hana Lee, +82 10-9988-7766, hana@hanatrans.co.kr (booked for 10/17 morning booth demos).
- Catering (booth snacks): Seoul Bites — order code SVF-Redwood-01, delivery 10/16 16:00, contact Ji-hoon Kim +82 2-555-8822.
- SIM / mobile: KT Roaming SIM kiosk at ICN arrivals — recommend buying pocket Wi-Fi if devices >2.

Expenses / receipts
- Expense categories to use in Concur: travel.flight, travel.lodging, travel.meals, travel.local_transport, travel-supplies.
- Per diem guideline: KRW 90,000/day (use receipts for anything over).
- Receipts: take a photo immediately and upload to Concur within 48 hours. For cash tips, add an itemized note with date/time.
- Foreign card fees: tag as expenses.bank_fees. CC last 4: 1234.

Reimbursement notes / billing code
- Use cost center: GROWTH-APAC-2024.
- Internal PO for booth: PO-5243 (contact Lucas Martin for invoice matching).
- Vendor invoices must be sent to finance@redwood.com with PO on subject line. For urgent vendor payments, cc: finance-ops@redwood.com and Lucas.

Day-by-day rough schedule (working)
- 10/16 (Wed): Arrive, hotel check-in, booth setup 15:00–18:00, quick run-through demo at 18:30.
- 10/17 (Thu): Conference day 1 — booth duty 09:00–12:30 (Samira), 13:30–17:00 (Ethan). Interpreter for AM demos. Evening: networking dinner 19:00 (RSVP list attached in Confluence).
- 10/18 (Fri): Conference day 2 — booth 09:00–14:00. Demo slot 11:00. Pack and hand off returns to KGL at 16:00.

To bring / packing checklist (personal + booth)
- Passport + backup photo of passport, wallet, travel adapter, pocket Wi-Fi password printed, business cards (50), dongles (HDMI->USB-C), spare battery pack, branded stickers, demo laptop + charger, dongle bag labeled REDWOOD.
- Print hard copies: 10 one-pagers, 3 slide decks for handing out, 20 swag items.

Loose open questions / TODOs
- Confirm reimbursement timeline (how long from submission to payout) — asked finance on 2024-09-28, no definitive answer yet.
- Do we have an extra HDMI cable in SJC office kit? If not, order 1 and expense it under travel-supplies.
- Confirm whether interpreter will translate technical slides live or just booth Q&A.

Notes to self
- Keep a running receipt folder in phone camera album named "SVF-Seoul-Receipts".
- If paying in cash, get merchant name legible on the receipt or take a photo of vendor business card.
- When returning, reconcile vendor invoices immediately so Lucas can close PO.

Quick reference numbers (save in phone)
- Embassy (non-emergency): +82 2-397-4114
- KGL Logistics contact: Min-jun Park +82 10-2345-6789
- Hana Translations: Hana Lee +82 10-9988-7766
- Onsite event ops: SVF Desk +82 2-3456-7700 ext 2

End of scratchpad — will tidy into a proper trip doc once logistics locked. For anything urgent ping me on Slack @samira or call +1 (415) 555-0192.
